name: Sayama Misaki
source:
Misaki is a female friend of [url=/c1633]Kouhei[/url]'s. She tries to get him not to interfere with [url=/c1630]Aeka[/url] because she doesn't want him to be picked on, though she does appear to have sympathy for [url=/c1630]Aeka[/url]. Often converses with [url=/c63389]Takeshi[/url].

[From [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Yume_Miru_Kusuri:_A_Drug_That_Makes_You_Dream]Wikipedia[/url]]
